forcing_mechanism.evidence: Contracts starting before 1 January 2027 earn up to 4,500 euros each, and the aid stops when payroll declaration data is missing.

findable.evidence: France Travail job ads name the employer, with codeNAF, trancheEffectifEtab and typeContrat fields to isolate firms under 250 staff.

early.evidence: Job ads are live and updated continuously, so hiring shows up before contracts start and before the 1 January 2027 cutoff.

gap_evidence.evidence: No catalogue dataset records which employers claim the aid, and claims run through the skills operator and payment agency.

crowding.evidence: The skills operator and payment agency already process the claim, and the award is automatic for firms under 250 staff.

list_recipes.filter: codeNAF 55, 56, 47 or 41-43; trancheEffectifEtab 10-249; typeContrat or intitule showing apprenticeship (apprentissage)
list_recipes.gap_evidence: Open apprentice ad dated before 1 January 2027, so the contract is not yet signed
list_recipes.metric: Open apprentice ads per company, times the 2,000 to 4,500 euros cap per contract
list_recipes.caveat: An open ad shows hiring intent, not an unclaimed aid, because the claim runs through the skills operator.

list_recipes.gap_evidence: None in the data; sector and size show eligibility only
list_recipes.metric: Count of in-scope establishments (siret) per company (siren)
list_recipes.caveat: SIRENE shows eligibility by size and sector, not apprentice hiring or aid claims.
